About

I'm a hands-on engineering leader: I can discuss an automation framework, investigate a delivery bottleneck, build a working prototype, and explain the investment to a client — in the same meeting.

Two decades across banking, payments, insurance, retail, and public-sector systems taught me one thing: quality holds when it's engineered in, not inspected in. These days that means applied AI — agents, spec-driven development, and evidence a planning meeting can rely on.

Home is Burlington, Ontario, where I live with my wife and our two boys. The work is important; it isn't the whole story.
